turns.text: Hi Rohit! I noticed you spend quite a bit of time bouldering and making loose-leaf chai. Do you find climbing gives you that same meditative focus as building systems?

That's such a poignant insight. In software we're obsessed with deterministic repeatability, but organic materials demand listening. What's your favorite spot when you need to disconnect completely?
The high alpine passes above Tuolumne Meadows. Setting up camp just as the granite turns pink in alpenglow, brewing warm roasted oolong tea. Do you prefer remote mountain camps or coastal spots?

Granite mountains every single time. There's a raw honesty to high altitude that grounds me. I make a mean cardamom-clove chai on a camp stove too—I'd happily challenge your oolong tea rituals on the trail.
A backcountry tea duel? That sounds like the best kind of bet. Beyond the outdoors, what kind of conversations make you lose track of time over dinner?

Conversations where neither person is performing. Digging into what we genuinely care about, why we make art or code, and laughing at the absurdity of it all. I feel like we could talk for hours without either of us needing to pretend.
